why: a colony holding a boost for each fighting part boosts every part type of a body it casts, each from its lab in turn: a big ranged Invader raid with its healer on an outpost is one a bare set cannot beat for what it costs, so the price takes the boosted rangers, lab waits and all, and they carry three compounds or more, each body one for every part type it has: none held off its lab by a carrier parked on its side leaves short. One body lost is the trade for the raid dying sooner: the set lands together 16 ticks earlier and its smallest ranger is focused; back to 0 once Exchange prices the pooled heal (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3)
